atlas.strategy: inherit only records whose applicability explicitly contains ЧМЭ3Э

schemes.strategy: inherit only family-common mechanical/diesel/fuel/oil/water/pneumatic functions explicitly applicable to ЧМЭ3Э; electrical circuit logic is overridden by the dedicated ЧМЭ3Э variant layer

hardExclusions: CHME3T rheostatic-brake schemes and runtime actions
integrationRule: A consumer must resolve common records through applicability, then overlay chme3e variant records. It must never copy the entire chme3t layer and subtract EDB heuristically.
